title: UneceSpecifiedCertification
description:
The process of certifying that a certain product, process or organization has passed performance tests, or qualification
requirements stipulated in a standard or regulation.

assertion.description: An assertion, expressed as text, for this specified certification.

assertionCode.description:
A code specifying an assertion for this specified certification, such as a claim that a product is free of hazardous
chemicals.

auditDateTime.description: An audit date, time, date time or other date time value for this specified certification.

endDateTime.description: The end date value for this specified certification.

identifier.description: An identifier for this specified certification.

relatedLocation.description: A referenced location related to this specified certification.

relatedStandard.description: A referenced standard related to this specified certification.

responsibleAgency.description: A responsible agency, expressed as text, for this specified certification.

specifiedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion for this specified certification.

standard.description: A standard, expressed as text, for this specified certification.

startDateTime.description: The start date value for this specified certification.

uRIId.description: A Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for this specified certification.
